name: comment-tray
title: Comment Tray
description: A game's comments as a bar at the foot of the screen that opens into a sheet, laid out the way Instagram lays out a post's comments: newest at the top, a pinned comment above them, replies folded under their comment, the box at the foot. The sheet is always mounted, so the list is drawn before it opens and nothing jumps in, and it follows a finger when dragged down. Posting has no confirmation word: the reader's comment lands at the top faded while it sends and turns solid when published, a failure offers Retry on the row, and a comment held for checking says only its author can see it. The reader's own comments carry a You label, a tint and an accent edge. One heart per comment, with double-tap to heart. Comments that arrive while the reader has scrolled away leave their place alone and are counted on a chip that goes back to the top. A long press offers Reply and Report, or Delete on the reader's own. It stores no comment, counts no heart and calls no service.
docs: Put `position: relative` on the screen the comments belong to and render the tray inside it: the bar sits at its foot and the sheet covers it when open; only the bar, and the sheet while open, take a tap. Pass `comments` as the top-level comments in any order, null while loading, and the tray orders them: pinned first, then newest first. Each carries `id`, `author`, `text` and `at` in epoch milliseconds, and may carry `avatarUrl`, `hearts` (the reader's own included), `hearted`, `mine`, `pinned`, `replyCount` and `replies` (undefined until loaded). Posting is optimistic and the state is yours: when `onPost(text, { replyTo, name })` fires, add the comment at once with `mine: true` and `status: 'sending'`, then set `status` to `published`, `held` or `failed`; the tray clears the box itself and scrolls to the reader's comment. Hearts are the same: flip `hearted` and the count the moment `onHeart(id)` fires. `canPost` is null while unknown, which draws the box disabled rather than a sign-in prompt that would flash; false with `onSignIn` draws a sign-in row. `onShowReplies(id)` fires when a comment's replies are unfolded and still undefined; fill `replies` and the tray draws them. `onReport` and `onDelete` appear in the long-press menu only when given, Delete only on the reader's own comments. `quickEmoji` is a list of one-tap emoji above the box and is empty by default: the library ships none. `avatars` draws a picture, or the fan's identity symbol, beside each comment and the box; it is off by default, so rows start at the name, and worth turning on only where fans have pictures. `showFaces` puts commenters' pictures in the closed bar, off by default, needs `avatars`, and draws only comments that have a picture. `nameRequired: { suggestion }` asks for a display name with the first comment. Every word is a `comment-tray.*` string, so a producer can change each one. Retune the sheet's height, the heart colour, the tint on the reader's own comments and the panel fill with `--gs-comment-tray-height`, `--gs-comment-tray-heart`, `--gs-comment-tray-mine` and `--gs-comment-tray-panel-fill`.
